summary: The expand/collapse documentation already describes the chevron row as the last row of the mobile card with a top border separator and the panel below it, matching the built code, so no rewrite was needed. I fixed the wiki metadata by adding title/covers front matter to the nine existing pages that lacked it, naming the source files each page describes.
notes: docs/expand-collapse.md and docs/api.md already described the mobile chevron row at the bottom of the card above the detail panel with a top border separator, matching src/UI/MobileView.tsx and src/Styles/ResponsiveTable.module.css, so they were left unchanged.
The 0.25rem spacing of the moved chevron row was not verified visually; the request itself flags this as unchecked.
The covers file lists for the nine pages were inferred from what each page's prose and examples describe, not from an explicit mapping in the repo.
